descriptions.catsroll_recommend: Use for vague good-cat/what-to-pull questions and trait gaps such as 빨적 부족. Returns a bounded ranked selection from reviewed SS/S/A/B/C/D and adjacent-range source ratings, joined by cat ID to current Catsroll names, per-form targets and abilities. total_candidates and returned_count describe this filtered selection, not the full banner roster. Preserve range labels; their lower end is only a sorting rule. No traits: best eligible candidates; explain low-tier caveats. Multiple traits: match=all unless user accepts any. Default allows 3rd form and ordinary talents, not 4th/ultra. State requirements and subjective within-series tier limits. Attached source_notes are dated opinions for the evaluated form/investment, not game facts or a global rank. For collection priority, distinguish collab scarcity from combat strength; never invent rerun schedules. Use catsroll_cats(details=true) for every sourced tier variant and individual role notes, including low tiers; do not infer missing characters are weak. event filters actual pool membership, NOT current sale or seed reachability. No seed needed for performance candidates; use catalogs and Find for actual pulls.
descriptions.catsroll_cats: Find exact character IDs by name (all forms) before selecting targets or seed-search rolls. Catalog filters need no seed. Optional event is an exact banner ID; it joins the selected banner pool to character records by ID. Optional rarity filters 2=rare, 3=super rare, 4=uber, 5=legend rare; with event it uses that banner’s actual rarity slots. Follow nextOffset until null to enumerate all matches. details=true (at most 5 results) adds current base-form abilities, available talent types, all source_ratings (including low tiers/ranges and upgrade variants), pending_evaluations and dated source_notes with explicit form/investment context. Distinguish collection scarcity, farming/combo roles and combat tiers; missing notes mean unreviewed, not weak.
